reviews.title: Great Renewed Hard Drive
reviews.comment: I've ordered these from this seller on a couple occasions now. The product has been in great condition with no issues. Being a renewed item, there is a chance for flaws to exist and with the work I do, I can't have faulty drives, so I test each one I get to validate them prior tp use. Every drive I've received from this company is like new, looks great, functions great, and no faults any where on the disk. I highly recommend them and will continue to purchase drives from them. Plus, super fast shipping.
reviews.author: Keith Francis

reviews.title: Not compatible with non enterprise servers.
reviews.comment: It requires a separate connector for non enterprise servers. It is because of power disable (PWDIS). I wanted use this for my NAS and can't use it in the hot swappable bays because of constant power my PSU was giving. Be aware that you might need an extra cable (which is provided).
reviews.author: Younes Nejahi

reviews.title: Works for now
reviews.comment: Was packaged better than expected. Drive had wiped SMART data I assume. I tested w/ badblocks and it ran for about 30-40 hours w/ no errors encountered, so all good with that. Drive gets hot during sustained workload, around high 40s to 50C in open air, so good airflow is needed. Dunno how difficult it would be for me to claim seller warranty/replacement after the return window passes.
